_note: Skeletal dragon text for every source without its own file in this folder: bare, old bone bound by magic; no flesh, no blood, no breath. Wounds are cracks, chips and splinters, and a faint glow where the binding magic shows. Shared keys first, then the block of the source's model (health / torture). Sources in skip keep humanoid text. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.
